While updated BoJ forecasts are expected to signal eventual normalization, carry trade flows continue to favor sterling over the yen. GBP/NZD stays firmly within its elevated channel as market participants weigh relative interest rate paths.

With both central banks navigating soft economic backdrop conditions, the cross exhibits range-bound liquidity around the 11.04 handle.

The Federal Reserve maintained its target policy rate during the October meeting, though market pricing reflects a 100% probability of a rate hike on December 9.
